Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps — MSA redline + onboarding cadence

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. Procurement and legal on our side reviewed the draft and want to run a short redline triage before the onboarding kickoff — mostly to confirm a few clauses and agree an evidence timeline. Can we schedule a 45-minute slot next week (window: Tue–Thu) that includes legal + procurement + one person from your security/compliance team?

I attached the version with our comments. Short list of priority items: data residency paragraph, audit log retention, and the indemnity language in section 7.3.

Attaching: Brightport_MSA_v2.docx (docx)

Proposed hosts: Lydia Price (procurement), Dave Peterson (legal).

Best,

Brightport — VP, Strategic Ops

Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — MSA redline + onboarding cadence

Hi Lydia —

Thanks for the attachment and the clear priority list. Ben (revenue ops) and Kim (legal liaison) are looped in. We can get our security/compliance lead on the call as well — Kim will coordinate.

Available windows next week (PT):
- Wed 22 Sep, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 22 Sep, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu 23 Sep, 08:30–09:15 PT

If none of those work, send two times that fit your legal team's schedule and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Action items for the meeting:
- Walk the three redline priorities you listed
- Agree evidence owners and timelines for SOC2 / audit logs
- Decide whether to accept our indemnity language as-is or move to a separate SOW carveout

I'll prepare a short checklist for the call and share a GDrive folder with the onboarding playbook and evidence matrix.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Lydia —

Thanks for the options. The legal team has a standing sync Wed 22 Sep at 17:00 GMT (10:00 ET) so the Wed 14:00 PT option (which is 21:00 CET for one of our EU counsel) isn't great. We can do Wed 22 Sep, 17:00 GMT / 10:00 ET / 07:00 PT if that works. If that timing is tight for Redwood's side, Thu 23 Sep 15:00 GMT / 08:00 PT would also work for us.

I've added inline comments on the data residency paragraph in the attached redline and flagged the audit-log item as high priority.

Can you also confirm who will cover: (1) evidence delivery for audit logs, (2) KMS key management owner, and (3) whether Redwood is willing to accept a 30-day retention exception for a named EU customer (we'll provide specifics if necessary).

Thanks,
Dave
General Counsel, Brightport

Perfect — Wed 22 Sep 10:00 PT works for our team. I've created a calendar invite and included a Googe Meet link plus a short agenda. Please find the prep materials here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMSAthread (read-only).

Quick answers before the call so we can be efficient:
- Evidence delivery (audit logs): Redwood will be the primary owner to deliver audit logs; Ben will coordinate sample exports and an access plan.
- KMS key mgmt: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via our KMS integration; Kimberly will bring the KMS playbook and a brief checklist to the call.
- Retention exception: We need specifics on the EU customer before we can commit; we can discuss the technical feasibility on the call and follow up with a short exception request template if needed.

Agenda (45 min):
1) 10 min — review redline highlights (data residency, audit logs, indemnity)
2) 15 min — evidence handoff & timelines (who/what/where)
3) 10 min — KMS and retention constraints (technical owner confirmation)
4) 10 min — next steps & DocuSign timeline

Related links: HubSpot deal BP-2027-049 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/BP-2027-049). I've also uploaded our onboarding playbook and a sample evidence export in the Drive folder.

See you on the call —
Marissa
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
